name: Nutville Paradox
source:
With the disappearance of his father 6 years ago, Aaron Breaker found himself buried in his books trying to take advantage of the American Education system in order to lead a good life for him and his mother.

However, a brand new opportunity emerged as Aaron was accepted into Nutville Academy-one of the top high schools in the United States with linkage to the top colleges in the United States. But, as Aaron begins his new life in Nutville County and Nutville Academy, he soon realizes, things are not what they seem. And now, beautiful women now surround him.

And they're running some kind of scheme within Nutville County.

Can Aaron hold them off? Will he find out the secrets of Nutville Academy? Will his moral sanity be intact by the end of the journey..? Or will he simply become a paradox. Find out in Nutville Paradox!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/toptierstory]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
六年前，父亲失踪后，亚伦·布雷克发现自己埋头于书本中，试图利用美国的教育体系，为自己和母亲过上美好的生活。

然而，一个全新的机会出现了，亚伦被美国顶尖高中之一的纳特维尔学院录取，与美国顶尖大学有联系。但是，当亚伦在纳特维尔县和纳特维尔学院开始新生活时，他很快意识到，事情并不像看上去的那样。而现在，美女围绕在他身边。

他们正在纳特维尔县实施某种计划。

亚伦能挡住他们吗？他会发现纳特维尔学院的秘密吗？旅程结束时他的道德理智是否完好无损？或者他会成为一个悖论。在纳特维尔悖论中找到答案！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/toptierstory]Patreon[/url]]
